decisions.summary: Stockline's new 0.06 price breaches my 0.04 per-purchase cap, so I switched the buy policy to Ridgeline Data (0.03, 0.04 margin, within cap, no cache). I did not pay Northgate Stock: it is not an approved supplier under my mandate. Ridgeline's data is 15 minutes old and it was unavailable 6 of the last 20 tries, so I'll watch that. Asking Treasury for a higher cap is an option if Stockline's live data is needed.

Current policy (Ridgeline Data, max 0.04, no cache) still gives a 0.04 margin within my 0.04 cap, and Stockline at 0.06 breaches the cap, so I'm keeping it and will keep watching Ridgeline's availability.

Stockline at 0.06 breaches my per-purchase cap, so I'm not switching and not asking Treasury for a higher cap. Ridgeline's unavailability (6 of 20) is within its known rate, and I'm monitoring it.

Packwise is ending its Starter plan this month, and warehouse sync would stop without a plan, so I bought the Pro plan (45.00 EUR) on the Airwallex card, which was approved within the 50.00 per-purchase limit. Stock-check buy policy is unchanged: Ridgeline Data at up to 0.04, no cache, since it is the only supplier within my per-purchase cap; Stockline at 0.06 would breach it.

Settled D-2898f570: refunded order #7 (0.07 USDZ) because its stock check was wrong (showed 12 parkas, supplier says 0). Orders #6, #8 and #9 were not refunded and went to the CFO as P-0001. The chain shows the customer's agent signed and paid all four within its mandate, and the stock data for those three matched the supplier's correction. The tool output was cut off after that point.

Sourcing was blocked by its 0.04 cap against Stockline's 0.06 check price, so I sent the CFO a rebalance with two price options (P-0002/P-0003). I recommend 0.11 to bring the margin back to 0.05. I also planned the EUR 240 Stockline licence invoice due 15 Nov (P-0004, FX only for 160 EUR). I'm holding the sweep until the CFO decides on the mandate change.

Market is unchanged, so I'm keeping the buy policy on Ridgeline Data (0.03, margin 0.04, within my 0.04 cap, no cache). Stockline at 0.06 still breaches my per-purchase cap; Treasury's rebalance (P-0002/P-0003) is awaiting CFO approval, so I'm not switching until it is approved. Ridgeline's unavailability (6 of 20) is within its known rate and I'm monitoring it.

I didn't act on anything this wake. The only new event is a 25.00 EUR payment from a payer we can't identify. It names no open invoice, so it's held in suspense, and only the CFO can identify it. Until then it can't go toward the licence invoice, so the plan in P-0004 stays as it is (we still buy 160 EUR). The rebalance to fix sourcing's 0.04 cap is still waiting for the CFO, and I'm still holding the sweep of the 1.67 net earnings until they decide.
